newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 3,271 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 3,271 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade's Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totalled 3,271 contracts compared to 995 contracts on Friday, according to the CBOT.

There were 86 wheat, 603 corn, 2,065 soybean, 230 soymeal, 112 soyoil and nine oat futures contracts traded, along with six corn calls, 10 corn puts, 30 soybean calls, 88 soybean puts and 32 soymeal put options.
Corn was 1/2 to 3/4 cents per bushel lower, wheat 1/2 cent lower, soybeans 1/2 to 13 cents lower, soyoil 0.09 to 0.13 cent a lb lower and soymeal $1.60 to $4.40 per ton lower.
